notes.title: Indies 2: Burning Kindling - New Demo Coming to Steam Next Fest 2025!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We're thrilled to announce that ​​Indies 2: Burning Kindling​​ – the direct sequel to Indies' Lies – will be available during ​​Steam Next Fest 2025​​ with a ​​FREE playable Demo​​!

This sequel evolves from deckbuilding into a core ​​Tactical Strategy (TRPG/Turn-Based Strategy) mode​​, while retaining the Roguelike spirit.

The Steam Next Fest 2025 demo will be your ​​first chance to experience the new tactical combat gameplay​​ and its Roguelike integration.

​​Add Indies 2: Burning Kindling to your Steam Wishlist​​ to be notified when the demo launches!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670960/Indies_2_Burning_Kindling/

See you at Steam Next Fest 2025!

notes.title: Devlog 01: Deck-building Festival and Development Progress Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/e76fcf26fc6295ca7ae26b7bc949676023306490.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, it's been a while!

I'm here to share some good news with you all — [b] "INDIES 2: BURNING KINDLING " has now joined the Steam Deck-building Festival![/b]

By the way, development of the game is going smoothly, pretty much as we expected!

The foundational features of the chess-strategy part have been completed, and next up, we'll be focusing on the DBG (Deck-building Game) aspect, as well as the Roguelike elements.

Here are some little teasers, of course, the game screenshots are not final versions~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/e63b7afe02a5e8411a6bab20b697144042a62d1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/235197dd3f4380f195ef25e4b0e8d12270c44d24.jpg[/img]

So, [b]if you're also interested in "INDIES 2: BURNING KINDLING," be sure to add it to your Steam wishlist![/b]

Wishing you all a happy day!

——Coffee

notes.title: Indies 2: Burning Kindling pre-order is LIVE now!!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I wish you all good luck in Chinese New Year of Dragon in advance. May you all be able to play the games you wanna play!

Since the first release of "Indies’ Lie" on Steam EA, it has been almost two years, and we would like to express our special thanks to the players who have supported us; during this period, we are also incubating a NEW game. The new game is still based on deck building, and it will incorporate some turn-based tactics gameplay elements. It is tentatively named[b] "Indies 2: Burning Kindling "[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860824/28022e89d74ace2413c27a791d4f513ffd301b46.jpg[/img]

[b]A PlayTest version will be available to everyone at the end of June this year.[/b] If you like DBG and turn-based tactics please add it to your wishlist~

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670960/Indies_2_Burning_Kindling/

As usual, let me briefly introduce our original intention for this new game. Based on our experience in "Indies’Lie", we hope to do more exploration and possibilities in the DBG gameplay to bring you a new experience; in Based on the basic model of "Indies’ Lie", we introduced some gameplay elements of turn-based tactics, hoping to have more choices and interest in player positions and target selection strategies; after several rounds of iterations of gameplay, and finally determined the feeling we wanted

Like the previous game, we take three characters to fight together. Considering that both DBG and turn-based tactics are relatively difficult to play—— DBG has a high threshold and is difficult to get started, while turn-based tactics is relatively unpopular and time-consuming, and both require certain strategies and much more thinking. In order not to let you are working too hard during the game, so we have made appropriate subtractions from the DBG part. The decisions and thinking in the turn-based tactics part are also tried to be rhythmically different from the DBG strategy, hoping to bring you a brand new experience.
 
The worldview of " Burning Kindling " also continues the previous one. The timeline is pushed back about 80 years. The entire continent of Mekka has been destroyed by the invasion of Magic Copper and has become fragmented. The people have been displaced. Our group needs to go through various experiences. Challenges in different forms, hoping to find a way to heal the Mekka continent and ignite the fire in people's hearts

New exploration will bring many challenges and difficulties, and there will be many shortcomings and trials and errors in the future. We hope that you can give us more inclusion, and we also very much hope that you can give us more feedback and support. We will actively Listen to your opinions and feedback, and actively iteratively optimize and improve quality

A few hundred words cannot express our love for indie games. We hope that " Burning Kindling " can bring players a brand new DBG game experience. We also thank all the players who have supported "Indies’ Lie" and all indie games in the past. Players, [b]if you have any questions or want to consult, you can join our discord to communicate with us.[/b]

https://discord.gg/qw96dwSpRe

See you there at the PlayTest at the end of March 2024.

—— Dev of Indies' Lie
